summary: Independently read all proposed citations and all upstream non-retain evidence. All three factual corrections are supported and agree with functionality.md and the rendered owned source. Existing retained knowledge and naming are inherited without cosmetic changes; acceptance is limited to changes and examined contradictions, not a new full baseline audit.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical shared physics assigns X and Y velocity before the local signed X addition. The table shares this callback across states 0–2, and active entry selects the stored bias sign. The correction distinguishes a per-update bias from cumulative acceleration.

State 3 has animation ID -1 and no animation callback. Collision invokes active entry only after the shared helper's contact and validation guards. Active entry preserves indices below 3, resets indices >=3 to zero, and contains no negative-index guard. The wrapper always returns false.

The appearance animation wrapper calls a void helper and independently returns false. Canonical helper branches confirm persistent scale and phase changes, no further work in phase 2, and delegation for other nonzero phases.
